name: Secured Finance Lending
rootCause: same-block self-trade manipulates getMarketUnitPrice to fabricate collateral. Lost: ~0.9 WBTC (~$72K single-drain; ~$104K across all actors exploiting the same public bug)

descriptions.text: same-block self-trade manipulates getMarketUnitPrice to fabricate collateral. Lost: ~0.9 WBTC (~$72K single-drain; ~$104K across all actors exploiting the same public bug)

Secured Finance’s fixed-rate lending protocol was exploited via an order-book accounting flaw that treated unfilled orders as filled and created invalid balances. Attackers used flash loans and self-trades to manipulate the current-block price and withdraw funds. Markets on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Filecoin were paused. The team’s preliminary loss estimate is about $180,000; no recovery has been confirmed.

Secured Finance’s Ethereum lending market was reportedly manipulated on 2026-09-05 through same-block order-book price inflation, with public trackers placing the loss at about $104,000. Public reports indicate that the lending market valued collateral from the current block’s order-book average execution price, and self-trades were able to inflate that price enough to overstate collateral value before the borrow was executed. The exact on-chain transaction sequence and vulnerable historical contract revision were not established in the available public evidence.
